policies.C1: exit 100% at FIRST_VALID_CAUSAL_OBJECTIVE (V0.5 primary rule); NOT_APPLICABLE when no causal objective exists at entry
policies.C2: partial f% at FIRST objective + runner (100-f)% to SECOND objective; NOT_APPLICABLE when no second objective exists
policies.C3: partial f% at FIRST objective + runner to FURTHEST objective; NOT_APPLICABLE when the ladder has a single objective
policies.C4: partial f% at FIRST objective + runner to the frozen fixed 5R ceiling; NOT_APPLICABLE when FIRST objective R >= 5
policies.R0: runner retains the original frozen SL (full -1R on the runner fraction if stopped after the partial)
policies.R1: NEW EXIT HYPOTHESIS: runner stop moves to entry (break-even) from the bar AFTER first-objective realization; BE counted FIRST within a bar (fail-closed); no spread adjustment (no authority)

controls.C0_1R: exit 100% at the frozen fixed 1R level; stop first; unresolved window => NULL
controls.C0_2R: exit 100% at the frozen fixed 2R level; stop first; unresolved window => NULL
controls.C0_3R: exit 100% at the frozen fixed 3R level; stop first; unresolved window => NULL
controls.C0_4R: exit 100% at the frozen fixed 4R level; stop first; unresolved window => NULL
controls.C0_5R: exit 100% at the frozen fixed 5R level; stop first; unresolved window => NULL

policies.fraction_rule: 3-point preregistered sensitivity grid; no percentage is promoted from DEV
policies.runner_rule: runner begins ONLY after the first objective is actually reached (no hypothetical credit); same-bar first+runner objective touch pays the runner objective (monotone path through the nearer level under the frozen stop-first scan)
policies.unresolved: no stop/target resolution inside the frozen 96-bar window => structural outcome NULL (UNRESOLVED/RUNNER_OPEN), never imputed, never a loss
